_notes.sampler_types: Sampler specs accept type: fixed, uniform, normal, exponential, or list. Parameters feed into src/sampling.js helper functions.
_notes.trial_modes: Set trial.mode to 'fixed_time' (uses trial.maxTimeSec) or 'max_bricks' (ends once cleared+dropped bricks reach bricks.maxBricksPerTrial after all active bricks resolve).

conveyors._comment: lengthPx and speedPxPerSec use the sampler shapes listed in _notes.sampler_types.

lengthPx._comment: Conveyor length in pixels; sampled once per conveyor each trial.

speedPxPerSec._comment: Pixels per second. Sampled once per conveyor at trial start.

bricks._comment: maxBricksPerTrial caps bricks spawned. With trial.mode set to 'max_bricks', the trial ends once this many bricks are cleared or dropped and none remain active.
bricks._comment_maxBricksPerTrial: Safety limit on total bricks per trial (spawned bricks only).

spawn._comment: Spawn timing uses sampler specs; ratePerSec influences Poisson-style spawn checks.

interSpawnDist._comment: Sampler (seconds) for the interval between spawn attempts.

trial._comment: mode can be 'fixed_time' (use maxTimeSec) or 'max_bricks' (end once the brick quota resolves).
trial._comment_maxTimeSec: Seconds per trial when mode is 'fixed_time'. Set null to disable the time cap.

selfReport.prompt: Please rate your workload during the last trial.

pages.title: Welcome
pages.html:
Welcome to the Conveyor Belt Bricks task. You will see bricks moving along several conveyor belts.

Your goal is to prevent bricks from falling off the right edge by clicking them before they drop.

pages.title: Dual Task
pages.html:
You will also perform a secondary Detection Response Task (DRT). Whenever a red square appears at the top of the screen, press the space bar as quickly as possible.

Try to maintain your performance on both tasks.

pages.title: Scoring
pages.html:
We track cleared bricks, dropped bricks, and DRT reaction times. At the end of each trial you will rate your workload.

Press the space bar when you are ready to begin.
